title: The False Prophet
text: A prophet stands on a milestone on the pilgrim road, ragged and burning-eyed, preaching that the Six are dead and the shrines are tombs. The pilgrims around him are listening. Some are weeping. Some have already thrown away their prayer beads.

options.label: The wisest debates him before the pilgrims.

outcomes.text: The pilgrims turn back to the road, picking up their beads.
He wins, and the pilgrims look at you with pity.
He makes a terrible kind of sense, and it stays with you, like a stone in the shoe.
The pilgrims scatter, and some of them run toward the Gate.
